metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Hepzibah, WV | Harrison County
metaDescription: Hepzibah, WV mineral owner near Clarksburg? We buy Harrison County fractional interests and old leases directly, checked at the courthouse before any offer.
heroLead: Hepzibah sits just southwest of Clarksburg in Harrison County, a small unincorporated community whose mineral tracts have been quietly leased and re-leased across more than a century of county-wide gas development.
intro: Hepzibah doesn't show up in headlines about Marcellus development the way Clarksburg or Bridgeport does, but the underlying leasing activity reaches this far out from the county seat regularly. Families here often hold interests that were leased decades ago and simply carried forward, generation to generation, without much active management.
We buy mineral and royalty interests around Hepzibah directly, confirming the current lease or unit status and your exact fractional share before making an offer.

sections.heading: Quiet ownership, real leasing history
paragraphs: A Hepzibah-area tract that hasn't generated a noticeable royalty check in years may still be under an active lease, particularly if it's part of a larger pooled unit where the well pad sits some distance away.

sections.heading: Older leases still governing many tracts
paragraphs: As with much of Harrison County, some Hepzibah-area leases predate the statutory conversion requiring flat-rate leases to pay a minimum one-eighth royalty. We check whether your family's lease qualifies before pricing the interest.

sections.heading: Confirming your fractional share
paragraphs: We trace the deed and probate record to confirm exactly what percentage of a Hepzibah-area tract your family holds, since these interests are frequently split among several heirs.
This step matters even more for a small unincorporated community like Hepzibah, where the original family tract was rarely formally surveyed and divided as heirs took their shares.

faqs.question: I haven't received a royalty check in years. Is my Hepzibah-area interest still active?
faqs.answer: It might be. We check current lease and unit status for your specific tract, since payments can be inconsistent or routed to an outdated address.

faqs.question: How do I know if my family's lease is a flat-rate lease?
faqs.answer: The recorded lease will specify either a fixed dollar amount per well or a royalty percentage. We review the instrument to confirm which applies.

faqs.question: My interest is split among several siblings. Can you buy just my share?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can purchase an individual heir's undivided interest without requiring the others to sell.

faqs.question: What if I've never seen a division order or check for this interest?
faqs.answer: That doesn't necessarily mean the interest isn't producing. Payments can be held in suspense by an operator who couldn't locate the current owner, which we check for as part of our review.
